reasons: The corrected claim removes the full-atlas and cycle-lift dependencies and adds the design-A fiber and singleton-rigidity definitions actually used by the proof.

narrow: The frozen claim incorrectly attributed a per-SCM randomized-monotone calculation to an unrestricted atlas value and did not state that the displayed SCM belongs to the design-A fiber. The replacement states the calculation for a specified compatible SCM and invokes the design-A target set only under a separate singleton hypothesis.

verdict.note: Accepted: the proposition now states the Tian--Pearl calculation for an explicit compatible SCM in F_A(p,m), with positive denominators justified by selected-table positivity and S=1. Singleton T_A(p,m) is invoked only for the separate conditional agreement clause and is not used to infer or prove unrestricted atlas rigidity.
